ValidationRule.description: This validation rule prevents Opportunities from being set to a stage with a Probability of 50% or more unless there is at least one line item or an approved Primary Quote associated with the Opportunity.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Application_Settings__c.Disable_Validation_Rules__c ), ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Closed Won – Pending Approval'), OR(NOT(No_of_Line_Items__c > 0), ISBLANK ( SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c), AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL( SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.ApprovalStatus__c ,'Approved')), NOT(ISBLANK ( SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__c)))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approved Primary Quote is required for Opportunity stage "Closed Won – Pending Approval". Please check if Opportunity Product exists.
